jobs.title: Data Programmer (UK - Hybrid)
jobs.description: Join a team that's going places! Every member of Celerion is involved in making a distinctive contribution to the health and well-being of people around the world. That's the sense of purpose shared by our employees. We are a performance-driven drug research company, operating in robust and growing markets. We have an exciting future and offer a strong development environment for our great employees. Come be part of our Data Management and Biometrics team as a Data Programmer . jobs.title: Partenaire commercial indépendant (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de PropertyOS PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique. Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier. Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat. 🚀 Votre mission En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution. Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre : Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative. Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition. Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS. Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel. Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés. Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté. 💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance. La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus. Le principe : valoriser concrètement les opportunités commerciales qui contribuent au développement de PropertyOS.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de service client – BtoC
jobs.description: Le contexte Supplyhub est un groupe en plein essor rassemblant plusieurs entités expertes dans la logistique, le transport, l’informatique et la relation client : SUPPLYWEB, ReGNR, FLOWZ, KINEXYA et SUPPLYFRESH. Au sein du groupe, nous gérons la logistique de nombreuses entreprises e-commerçantes. Et notre service client BtoC a une particularité : il agit en véritable prolongement de nos clients ! Nous intervenons directement en leur nom et à leur place pour répondre aux demandes de leurs clients finaux. Contrat et lieu de mission On te propose un CDD de 3 à 6 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation. Si tu fais tes preuves, la partie peut continuer plus longtemps ! Le poste est basé à Démouville (Caen la mer). Du lundi au vendredi (repos le samedi et le dimanche) Horaire : 8h30-12h et 12h-16h30 Tes responsabilités : Gestion quotidienne : Intervenir au nom de nos clients e-commerçants pour répondre aux demandes de leurs clients finaux (par tickets ou téléphone). Ton but : t’assurer de la bonne livraison des colis (suivi des litiges, gestion des affrètements, numéros de suivi et communication). Analyse : Identifier et analyser les problématiques et les insatisfactions des consommateurs finaux afin de faire remonter les points bloquants. Amélioration continue : Réfléchir et mettre en place des plans d’action concrets pour améliorer la qualité de service rendue à nos partenaires et à leurs clients. Polyvalence : Assurer un back-up sur les appels du standard téléphonique de l’entreprise et sur la gestion courante des clients BtoC. Le profil que nous recherchons : Tu as une expérience sur un poste de service client Tu connais le monde de la logistique et du transport Tu es connu pour ta plume : tu maîtrises la syntaxe et de l’orthographe Très à l’aise avec les outils informatiques, tu navigues facilement d’une plateforme à l’autre Doté.e d’un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, tu sais mener l’enquête pour résoudre les anomalies Tu possèdes une aisance relationnelle naturelle

jobs.title: Social Media Manager Stage
jobs.description: Des idées de Reels plein la tête et l'envie de les mettre au service d'une marque de cosmétiques bio ? On cherche notre futur·e stagiaire Social Media Manager pour 6 mois, à Paris, dès que possible. Qui sommes-nous Sanoflore est une marque de cosmétiques bio née dans le Vercors. Laboratoire bio depuis 1986, la marque cultive son jardin botanique et formule ses soins dans le Parc Naturel Régional du Vercors, avec un siège à Paris. Nos soins sont certifiés bio, vegan et fabriqués en France. Au sein de l'équipe marketing, tu contribues à faire grandir la présence de la marque sur les réseaux sociaux. Tes missions 1. Création de contenus social media Imaginer des concepts et formats adaptés à chaque plateforme (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Shorts) Proposer des contenus créatifs, en phase avec les codes des réseaux et l'univers de la marque Créer des visuels fixes, carrousels, stories et vidéos Tourner et monter des vidéos courtes pour les Reels et TikTok Travailler le rythme, les effets, les accroches et le storytelling Décliner les campagnes, lancements, temps forts produits et marronniers en contenus digitaux 2. Animation et gestion des réseaux sociaux Programmer et publier les contenus Participer à l'animation des communautés et aux échanges avec les abonnés Repérer les comptes qui parlent de la marque et développer les interactions avec eux Identifier des profils influenceurs et UGC pertinents 3. Veille et culture digitale Suivre les tendances beauté et lifestyle, les formats viraux et l'évolution des plateformes Repérer les actualités sur lesquelles la marque peut rebondir Proposer régulièrement de nouveaux concepts, angles et mécaniques de contenus 4. Performance et analyse Participer aux reportings hebdomadaires et aux bilans de campagnes Analyser les contenus qui fonctionnent et identifier les leviers d'amélioration Formuler des recommandations pour les prochains contenus 5. Communication digitale Selon l'actualité et les besoins de l'équipe : Rédiger des posts

Tasks As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include: Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection. Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless. Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests. Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio. Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices. Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps. Requirements Experience: A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving. Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits. Nice to have: LiveKit Agents , pipecat or WebRTC. Fine-tuning (LoRA or full) of speech or language models. Audio signal processing such as echo cancellation or noise suppression. German, or experience with German-language speech data. Communication: English

jobs.title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
jobs.description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique. PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens. Vos missions Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier. Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes. Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients . Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions

jobs.description: We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform. Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 . About the role As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built. We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it. jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. About The Role This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO. We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster

We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. jobs.description: Our mission We re making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That s for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We re solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don t always work, you can still send money with Wave. jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer - Tracking Infrastructure (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics. jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description: The Role BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them. The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production. What You'll Own Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives. Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability. Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices. Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams. What We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production. Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems. Nice to have Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth. Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries. Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zone

jobs.title: Director of Security Operations and Engineering
jobs.description: A Little About Us EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com The Role: You'll lead Security Operations and Security Engineering at EDB, reporting to the CISO as a trusted member of the security leadership team. You own how we detect, respond, and (increasingly) prevent. That means the people, the platforms, and the playbooks behind threat detection, incident response, and the engineering that makes them scale. You'll be a peer to the leaders across security, including Governance, Risk & Compliance and Application Security & Vulnerability Management, and you'll help shape the direction of the broader InfoSec organization. jobs.description: Über uns: Wer ist Modumat und was treibt uns an? Wir sind Modumat – und wir gestalten die Zukunft der smarten, nachhaltigen Warenausgabe! Klassische Verkaufsautomaten sind oft klobig, unflexibel, wartungsintensiv und verbrauchen unnötig viele Ressourcen. Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengestützt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag – von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels. Hinter Modumat stehen wir: Raphael und Frederik , zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp läuft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde jüngst mit der Dörte-Wörner-Innovationsförderung ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Frühjahr unseren Master abschließen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das EXIST-Gründerstipendium , um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen. Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied – die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive für unser Gründungsteam! Was du bei Modumat bewegst Als kaufmännische und kommunikative Säule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und Märkten, die sie brauchen: Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation: Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere Lösung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (über LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen). B. moderne 24/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger*innen der Branche Lösungen, die Gäste und Hotelteams gleichermaßen begeistern. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung, 2.800 Mitarbeitenden aus 43 Nationen und 33 Standorten weltweit verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit tiefem Branchenverständnis.   Wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft des internationalen Mittelstands und von Großunternehmen. Als treibende Kraft für digitale Transformation implementieren wir komplexe, globale Microsoft Dynamics 365 Multiworkload-Architekturen (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, CE). Dabei gehen wir neue Wege: Wir verknüpfen klassische Projektmethodik mit den modernsten KI- und AI-Werkzeugen , um Projekte schneller, transparenter und effizienter zum Erfolg zu führen. WAS DICH ERWARTET: Beraten & Anleiten : Du berätst im Rahmen eines fachlichen Projektteams unsere Kunden bei der Einführung von ERP im Bereich Microsoft Dynamics Finance. Du gestaltest innovative Konzepte mit und setzt diese in nationalen und internationalen Projekten um. AI-Driven Consulting:  Du nutzt aktiv modernste KI-Tools (z. B. Microsoft Copilot, generative KI für die Dokumentation und KI-gestützte Agenten) Umsetzen und Integrieren : Im Rahmen von Prozess- und GAP-/FIT-Analysen ermittelst du die Bedürfnisse der Kunden, definierst eine zugeschnittene Lösung auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics und vor allem auf Finance. Dabei gestaltest du mit dem Team Empfehlungen zur Prozessoptimierung und empfiehlst diese dem Kunden. Du erkennst dabei eigenständig den Nutzen und die Einsatzmöglichkeit neuer Technologien. Du leitest das Team, die Software zielorientiert einzustellen und zu konfigurieren, behältst immer die Qualität der Datenmigration im Blick und verantwortest die nahtlose Integration der Dynamics 365 Lösung in die bestehende IT Landschaft. Verantwortliches Handel

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Engineer, MEMS Development
jobs.description: About SiTime SiTime is the Precision Timing company. Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com . Job Summary Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. jobs.description: About us EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase. Your role You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment. jobs.title: AI Builder — Working Student
jobs.description: EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany) Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems. EggAI Labs We re opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they d improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI s mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale. As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI s CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role. The problem: EvalOps How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions? We will explore  EvalOps : the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way. These questions will guide the initial work: Regression suites : How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales? Coverage estimation : How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors? Live monitoring : Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals? jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences-projecten? Ontwerp geavanceerde, duurzame installaties voor high-tech laboratoria, waar jouw expertise écht het verschil maakt. Bij Deerns krijg je de ruimte om complexe projecten te leiden en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van wetenschap en gezondheidszorg. De uitdaging Als Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch productiefaciliteiten, zoals laboratoria. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen. Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme. Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten. Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels. Deine ersten 90 Tage Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies. The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution. Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions. Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems. Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. You’ll implement and drive best practices in technology, architecture, and process while optimizing funnels, automating growth loops, and shipping features that drive measurable impact. You’ll have the chance to work in an open and collaborative environment, receive and give hands-on mentorship, and have opportunities to grow and accelerate your career. You love both learning and teaching, enjoy working cross-functionally to solve hard problems, and strive for quality — obsessing over automation, performance, and squashing any bugs that sneak through. Our tech stack: Ruby/RoR, React.js, TypeScript, Redux, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Ansible, Terraform

jobs.description: Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. jobs.description: An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short. We are Montu UK , one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK. You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care. What you will be doing: Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment. Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management. jobs.title: Women’s Health Consultant (Remote, Ireland)
jobs.description: Too many women spend years being told their pain is normal. They wait a long time for a diagnosis, cycle through treatments that do not work for them, and often end up managing debilitating symptoms on their own. At Montu, we see these patients every day. Many arrive with exhausted conventional options for conditions like endometriosis, PMDD and menopausal symptoms, and for a significant number, medical cannabis is the first treatment that has genuinely improved their quality of life. We are looking for Women's Health Consultants to join us on a permanent basis. This is real clinical work with real outcomes. jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
